interface Prefixed {
  [key: `a${string}`]: number;
}
interface LongerPrefixed {
  [key: `ab${string}`]: string;
}
interface NarrowsLonger extends Prefixed, LongerPrefixed {
  [key: `ab${string}`]: 1;
}
interface RedeclaresShorter extends Prefixed, LongerPrefixed {
  [key: `a${string}`]: string;
}
interface Scores {
  [name: string]: number;
}
interface Labels extends Scores {
  [name: string]: string;
}
interface FirstBaseWins extends Scores, Record<string, string> {}
interface ClashesWithInherited extends Prefixed, LongerPrefixed {
  [key: `a${string}`]: 1;
}
